steps.content:
Thirteen minutes and twenty-eight seconds after the MBCC's Chief went out of control, Mania subsides, and the DisSea's Illusory Moon is observed to have disappeared.
The fourth anomalous tide ends. BR-000 has regained peace for now.

All missing persons have been found, with no casualties. Those survivors who were brought back earlier are also recovering from their mental disturbance. No one has suffered any permanent physical or mental damage. After rehabilitation at the hospital, they will be discharged back to the DisSea frontline.
[Banyan Hospital - Ward]

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: I can't remember what exactly happened in the dream. Or maybe I don't want to remember... It still spooks me out...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: The only thing I remember is a few small flames. I think someone told me to follow them to get out of the phenomenon...

When Mania broke out, the last survivor to escape the mutated area ran into the reinforcements entering the zone. Guided by him, the troops soon reached Monitoring Station 1 safely.

However, the other information he's provided is yet to be verified...
[FAC HQ - Background]

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: I requested support immediately, but when we rushed to the site, we failed to find that abandoned camp despite rigorous search efforts. That child named Hestia was also nowhere to be found.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: The Ring Research Institute says it was a Mania-induced illusion, kind of like a daydream... I'll take that explanation. After all, the phenomenon is gone now. Chief has been at the MBCC this whole time. Once he wakes up, we can hear his side of the story and find out.
steps.female_content: The Ring Research Institute says it was a Mania-induced illusion, kind of like a daydream... I'll take that explanation. After all, the phenomenon is gone now. Chief has been at the MBCC this whole time. Once she wakes up, we can hear her side of the story and find out.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: But... if all of that was real, then Chief...

Three days later, the MBCC's Chief also regains consciousness and is confirmed to be free of significant physical or mental issues upon examination.

According to his account, a member of the expedition has been identified. Named Hestia, she is a Sinner whose ability is telepathic ignition. The spiritual energy she yields during this process can disperse Mania to a certain extent.
Hestia is suspected to be spiritually gifted and highly sensitive to Mania fluctuations. Similar cases were recorded in a few regions during the first few years after Nightfall. Her exact age and real name are unknown. Further information to be added.

Hestia is suspected to be spiritually gifted and highly sensitive to Mania fluctuations. Similar cases were recorded in a few regions during the first few years after Nightfall. Her exact age and real name are unknown. Further information to be added.

steps.content:
During Chief's coma, the vast data recorded by Schorl has been transferred to the Ring Research Institute, Banyan Medical College, and other core Paradeisos authorities.

The fourth Illusory Moon tide has ended. But for humanity's operations in the DisSea and the exploration of the expedition's history a century ago as well as the truth behind the Perishing Star, this is only the beginning.
[MBCC Medical Room]
You open your eyes and see Schorl floating before you.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The people behind me are more than relieved to see that you're unharmed, Chief.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This Illusory Moon tide was very unique. You were able to remain rational in the depths of Mania and bought precious time on the most dangerous frontline. It's the first time humanity has retrieved this amount of invaluable <color=#fb9259>data</color>.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: EDGE-01 has specifically asked me to relay his sincere salute to you, saying your growth compared to a few months ago has exceeded his expectations. He's expressed his gratitude.
You don't answer or look up, just staring at your hands.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What purpose will these data serve?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We're still in the preliminary analysis phase, but based on the current findings, not only can they reveal the truth behind the Illusory Moon tides, but they may also completely change the strategies for future operations in the DisSea.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Before the mystery of the DisSea is solved, the Illusory Moon tides will not cease. But by the next cycle, you will definitely receive better protection. The overall approach in the DisSea might also shift from defensive to offensive, with humanity taking the initiative to unearth the truth.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is all thanks to your contributions. Well done, Chief.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'm exhausted. I'd like to be alone for a while.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Of course. I came to say goodbye to you. The operation has come to an end. At your request, I will leave the MBCC, in honor of our mutual trust.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Farewell, Chief.
Finally, you are alone in the room.
The bedding is warm. The aroma of the bouquet on the desk is soothing. As sunlight pours in, you find that you've regained all your senses. Everything feels warm and bright.
You will no longer return to that dark dream. You can only struggle in vain trying to grasp that slowly fading memory.
You've also walked in that cold, suffocating darkness, with only a single light beside you.
You've tried countless times to catch up to it, to hold it tightly in your hands, not wanting to lose that fragile, perplexed, yet stubborn fire.
You want to ask if it was trying to tell you something by flickering so vigorously. At that moment of departure, what did she really say to you?
Luckily, you finally remember...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Don't worry, you're the guide... We will always follow you...</color>
[Back to the Room]
You finally unclench your tight fist, but there's no spark in your hand, only a red mark.
It's not a burn scar, only a bloody mark left by your nail from the too-tight grip.
